summary: Update an installed role to another version with ansible-galaxy install namespace.role,version --force, and update dependent roles if needed.
questions: How do I upgrade an installed Galaxy role?
How do I switch an installed role to a different version?

answer_card.title: Update an installed role
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy install mynamespace.my_role,v2.7.1 --force
```
Check the role's Galaxy **Read Me** for dependent role versions, which you may need to update too.
